about: The bowed strings' methods (registry/README.md): what each does, and its settings, each with why that value and what it answers to.

strings-neutral.about: The strings' neutral note at each string and stop, the first stage of the player's fit by decomposition (native/strings-model/neutral.py; the owner, 27 October 2026): each string at ordinario, at each stop and dynamic, every force of a grid from silence with no attack curve on every seed, its window the longest run that holds Helmholtz motion, its neutral note that window's middle among the forces players bow; then held from it at mf, the levels against the measured instruments', the dynamics' rounds by speed and force until they hold, the law and its check through the compiler, and adoption where every note was heard.

ratio.reason: the force grid's step: a quarter of an octave of force, finer than the windows' own structure (the viola's run at 1.05 N between 0.75 and 1.48), 27 forces on the viola from 0.12 N to 10

stopStep.reason: its stops from the law's lowest to its highest about this many semitones apart, none of them twelve-tone, so that a law read between them is checked between them

near.reason: a round after the first maps each note's forces this many grid steps either side of the one its law predicts

reach.reason: the grid extended past its top, a step at a time, while a note's window from silence still holds there, at most to this many times its top: the viola's map of 27 October had 58 of its 384 notes' windows cut by its top, their neutral notes the middle of a window that went on

holds.reason: the dynamics' rounds are done where no note's correction is over this

listenGap.reason: the silence between the neutral notes rendered to hear

check.reason: how long each note the check compiles is held, at the violin's lowest pitch and above (a lower one as many periods: notePeriods)

notePeriods.reason: each test note held as many periods as the violin's lowest note gets in regions.py's note (0.6 s at 196 Hz, about 118): a low string's start measured as long, in its own periods, as a high one's -- some contrabass notes settle past 0.6 s (the owner, 28 October 2026: 'it's possible that some double-bass notes will need it'); its settling still judged against Guettler & Askenfelt's limits, so a slow note is measured, never passed

offsetRead.reason: a heard note's offset read over its render's first this long, before its bow

listenPeakDb.reason: the neutral notes rendered to hear brought together to this peak

peakFloor.reason: a silent render's peak taken as this, so it is never divided by zero

levelFloor.reason: a note's mean square floored here, so a silent note's level is finite

lineNotes.reason: a string's level errors corrected by a line through its stops where it has this many notes at a dynamic, else by their mean

strings-regions.about: Each string's windows of Helmholtz motion over contact and force, from silence and held (native/strings-model/regions.py), and the attacks measured on them: the reference notes every bowed fit plays.

forces.reason: each window's coarse grid: this many forces log-spaced from the robot's least force to WIDEN past the players' most

contacts.reason: this many contacts log-spaced from the bridge's mechanical limit to the midpoint

edgeRatio.reason: each window's edge found to within this ratio of force

widen.reason: the grid's top this many times the players' most

widenings.reason: a bracket widened at most this many times

robotLeast.reason: the grid's bottom: the bowing robot's least force (its grid's, schelleng-map forces), times the instrument's force scale

midpoint.reason: the contact axis's tasto end, the vibrating length's midpoint (the owner, 19 October 2026: extreme sul tasto is 0.5 of the string)

ramp.reason: a reference note's bow brought up to speed in this (noise_profile.actions')

note.reason: a reference note held this long and classified on its last half, at the violin's lowest pitch (a lower one longer: strings-neutral notePeriods)

gap.reason: its string damped over this before the next note

slide.reason: a sustained note's finger slid and its bow brought to its speed over this (glide.py's, which held)

glide.reason: then glided to its contact and force over this

attackSeconds.reason: each attack measured at these attack times (a stroke's, MIDI 2.0 RPNC #73; under 0.02 s the compiler sets its bow down at its whole force at once, and past the last an attack takes the last's)

froms.reason: its starting force a share of its held force on a grid of this many

reaches.reason: its force brought to its own over each of these times its attack time

held.reason: each attack's note twice its attack and this much more long (the compiler's attack at most half its note, its release after)

attackTimes.reason: each attack's note this many times its attack long, and HELD more: the compiler's attack at most half its note

nearFastest.reason: an endpoint's curves near its fastest: settling within a period or this share of the fastest of it

perUnknown.reason: the attack model's features fewer where its endpoints are under this many an unknown, the last dropped first

agreeAbsolute.reason: the compiler and the model agreeing within this and agreeRelative: a force to the gram, a time to a tenth of a millisecond, as the compiler rounds them

agreeRelative.reason: and within this share of the value

same.reason: two stops or contacts the same within this: a float's rounding

keyDigits.reason: a render's key, its actions' hash, this long

engineDigits.reason: an engine build's stamp, its binary's hash, this long

classifierDigits.reason: the classifier's stamp, its source's and its settings' hash, this long

jobs.reason: renders at once: three, the trunk's share for a strings fit

strings-compiler.about: The bowed strings' compiler (public/shared/performers/physical-strings.js): how it writes a part's notes as the strings engine's actions, which every fit, render and the band play.

versions.reason: how many versions of each instrument the engine holds, a seat taking one by its chair (physical-strings.js MODEL.variants): a section's seats not all one instrument -- the violin's, viola's and cello's each one of Artifastring's string sets (objects: violin.0 to cello.2)

forceWritten.reason: the least step of force the compiler writes (physical-strings.js toFixed(3)): a bracket never under it, a cost's noise measured at least this far apart

contactWritten.reason: the least step of contact the compiler writes (physical-strings.js share, to five places): a span's far end where no measurement bounds it

tuneWritten.reason: a string's tension ratio written to seven places: a change under this not written

same.reason: two values the same within this: a float's rounding, never a choice of the music's

instant.reason: a time under this is none: a bite or a stop shorter is no stop, and a stroke's bows end this inside its limit

leastAccelerating.reason: a bow's acceleration figured over this at least: a speed reached over less, taken as reached over this

leastAttack.reason: a stroke's attack never shorter than this

readyBefore.reason: a stroke's or a pluck's finger readied to be there this long before it

dampBefore.reason: a string's losses set back this long before its stroke, before its finger is readied

releaseAfter.reason: a release begun no sooner than this after its stroke begins (or half its note, the shorter)

tail.reason: a part's end this long after its last change, where its driver does not ring it down: its strings turned off where they fell quiet

pitchWithin.reason: a pitch sounds as asked within this: a stroke whose path begins further off its pitch glides into it, a multiphonic asked further from its own is said to sound at its own

strings.reason: every instrument the engine plays has four strings (Artifastring's)

fingerPasses.reason: a finger placed again for the cents its geometry sounds off (the calibration's) at most this many times

fingerOutlier.reason: a finger's measured correction further than this from its string's reliable centre taken for one that failed (a note that did not speak, or read at another partial: violin variant 2's E string read -198 and +677 cents where its others read +27, Op. 3.9's first render), read between its reliable neighbours instead -- a finger the model places by geometry is never a semitone out; its reliable corrections lie within some 30 cents of each other

moved.reason: the driver's lines whose change is moved over time (native/strings-model/musebots-strings.cpp), by kind, and how many values each takes before its span: the driver's protocol

contactHeld.reason: a contact neither given nor measured -- the measured players' by dynamic (bowed-line.js BOWED_LINE.contact) -- held within this: beyond it the model leaves Helmholtz motion and squeaks or whistles

leastFinger.reason: the least a finger stops a string: nearer the nut the model's finger, a stiff spring on a piece of string that hardly moves, overshoots until its numbers overflow (Op. 3.5's second violins at 0.006; violin variant 2's E string at 0.03, Op. 3.9's first renders); at 0.045, its next stop measured, it plays. A pitch nearer its open string keeps its finger there, its string's tension lowered so the two sound it

openWithin.reason: a note within this of its open string is the open string

retuneSemitones.reason: a string's tension never raised past this, which only a failed correction could ask: a finger that reaches the pitch by its geometry stops it there instead

mostRetune.reason: retuneSemitones as a ratio of the string's tension's pitch

pluckLead.reason: the model pulls a plucked string this long before it lets go (its driver's PLUCK_SECONDS), so a pluck is asked that much early

step.reason: a finger's path -- a vibrato, a slide -- written a straight segment this long at a time

joined.reason: a stroke joined to the one before where it begins within this of that one's end (a change of bow's bite counted in)

drawStep.reason: a drawn bow's wandering written a straight segment this long at a time

drawnLeast.reason: a stroke drawn with its bow's wandering where it is held this long or longer -- never a multiphonic's, bowed as it was measured, nor a tremolo's

strings-bowing-law.about: The bowed strings' bowing law fitted (native/strings-model/fit_bowing.py; research/STRINGS_FITTED_BOWING.md): each instrument's windows of Helmholtz motion mapped over contact and force as a seat plays them, then the law's four values -- its contact at ppp and fff, its place in each window at ppp and fff -- fitted by descent through the physics, never by draws: least squares by a trust region tolerant of the cost's noise (trust_region.py: Sun & Nocedal 2023), the cost's noise measured at its start (ECnoise: More & Wild 2011) and each value's difference step from the cost's curvature (More & Wild 2012); its residuals each note's levels against the measured instruments', how its spectrum changes from pp to ff against the recordings', and each value's distance from its measured range's middle.

betaRange.reason: the windows' grid of bow-bridge distances, log-spaced over this: from near the bridge to over the fingerboard's end, the measured players' 0.03-0.3 and beyond

forceRange.reason: the windows' grid of forces, log-spaced over this, the violin's (an instrument's times its force scale): from a light touch to past the heaviest measured, 2.5 N

seeds.reason: each point's and note's attack played under the driver's seeds 1 to this, stopping at the first that leaves Helmholtz motion: a bow is in its window only where every attack of it settles there. At the calibration's mezzo-forte on a violin's E string (vn1.2, note 81), 15 of 32 attacks on the ramped driver settled 6 dB softer, their fundamental 1 dB over their octave against 13 dB (claude-scratch/strings-ramps/logs/reattack-seeds-1.log), and the classifier finds each of those 16 notes' 8 soft ones in multiple slip, two slips a period, the 8 others in Helmholtz motion (classify-reattack-3.log): one seed had judged that bow by chance. A bow whose attacks fail one time in two is found failing under five seeds 31 times in 32

scored.reason: the law's notes played at these dynamics: each note's pp and mf level judged under its ff, its spectrum's change from pp to ff

steps.reason: each string's notes a quarter tone over its open pitch, a fourth up and an octave up, microtonal: none on a twelve-tone step

noteSeconds.reason: each note the compiler plays for the windows and the law held this long, its attack's held part (half its note to its release) classified

compared.reason: each note's spectrum's change from pp to ff compared over its first this many harmonics, dB under its loudest

points.reason: the cost's noise measured from this many plus one laws (More & Wild's own driver's m, ECNdriver.m), first one written step of the lightest force apart (strings-compiler forceWritten)

margin.reason: a law's contacts kept this far inside their windows' edges: the bound solver's tolerance

betas.reason: the windows' grid this many bow-bridge distances where none are asked (--betas), log-spaced over betaRange: neighbours 30% apart

forces.reason: the windows' grid this many forces where none are asked (--forces), log-spaced over forceRange: neighbours 32% apart

lawDigits.reason: a law's folder named by this many hex digits of its values' hash, so a run resumed reuses only the same law's notes

changeWithin.reason: a note's change from pp to ff compared with the recorded note nearest its pitch only where that one lies within this: the recordings' notes are a semitone apart (render/synthesis/harmonic-spectra), so this admits a note at most two semitones past their compass

ordinarioPoints.reason: ordinario sought among this many contacts log-spaced over the measured players' (0.03-0.3: a step of 0.6% of contact)

strings-player.about: The strings' player fitted to whatever instrument the engine builds, every playing value in one descent (native/strings-model/fit_player.py): its contacts and places in each string's windows by dynamic, the force's and the bow speed's multiples at the marks past ppp and fff, the onset curve, the change of bow -- the instrument held as built, the player fitted to it.

upsample.reason: a bridge force interpolated, band-limited, to this many times its rate before its flybacks are timed (its jitter)

jitterPeriods.reason: a jitter read only where this many flyback-to-flyback periods or more were timed: ours, a spread of fewer says little

centroidHarmonics.reason: a held part's brightness its first this many harmonics' centroid: ours

centroidBand.reason: each harmonic's magnitude its spectrum's peak within f0 over this of it: ours, an eighth of the spacing between harmonics

startWithin.reason: a start's value taken as within its range, and its bounds, to this: a logarithm's and its exponential's rounding, never moved for it

compilerDigits.reason: the compiler's stamp, its sources' hash, this long

compileDigits.reason: a compile kept by its job's and the compiler's hash, this long

most.reason: the descent's evaluations at most, a guard: it ends where its steps promise no more than the noise or change no note

strings-loop.about: The strings' fit as one loop that runs to its end unattended (native/strings-model/fit_loop.py): its stages in order, each kept by what it measured, and the band its adoption is heard in before and after.

band.reason: the band an instrument's adoption is heard in, rendered as it plays before and after, every note against its stem: ours, the strings' realtime objective (17 October 2026)

bandSeconds.reason: the band rendered this long: ours

bandSeed.reason: the band rendered at this seed, fixed so before and after play the same piece (the owner, 1 October 2026: a fixed default seed is ok): the date the loop was written

calibrationDigits.reason: the band's check kept by its calibration's and onsets' files' hash, this long

strings-onsets.about: An attack's onset read from its sound (native/strings-model/fit_onsets.py accent, the player's fit's too): its level frame by frame from its stroke to its release, the loudest frame of its onset against the median of its held part's.

accentFrame.reason: its level read in frames this long: ours

accentAttack.reason: its onset read from its stroke over this, then its articulation's decay (bowed-articulation.js), then accentAfter: ours, written with the onsets' fit (19 October 2026) with no reason recorded

accentAfter.reason: and this past its decay: ours, written with the onsets' fit with no reason recorded

changeBefore.reason: an attack at a change of bow follows a note held this long on the same string: ours

note.reason: each attack's note held this long, its held part the later half of its frames: ours

periodsScale.reason: the onsets' fit's transient residual in this many periods: about the reading's own step (one period, a window a period apart, over four): ours

accentScale.reason: its accent residual in this many dB: about a level's just-noticeable difference: ours

ranges.reason: the onset's speed and force multiples (physical-strings.js onsetOf) sought within these: ours, no measurement bounding them

noiseSpacing.reason: the onsets' fit's cost's noise first measured over steps of this ratio in each value (ECnoise's spacing, moved as it advises): ours

noiseTries.reason: its spacing moved at most this many times before the noise is said not found

most.reason: the onsets' fit's evaluations at most

strings-engine.about: The one bowed-string engine as Musebots build it (native/strings-model/engine.mjs): Artifastring patched, with one body for every program -- its tables baked from the measured bodies' corrections and their radiation, the contrabass's the cello's stretched to its size.

dcBlockHz.reason: the offset from zero the bow's friction leaves in Artifastring's sound blocked under this, first order, from silence

kaiserBeta.reason: a body's impulse response stretched in time read between its samples by a Kaiser-windowed sinc of this beta: a stretch only narrows the band, so nothing folds back

sincHalf.reason: that sinc this many samples either side

scaledBins.reason: a minimum-phase body filter scaled to a body's size read and remade at this many frequency bins

bowContact.reason: the bow's contact as measured: its hair's give in series with each cell of the ribbon, the string's losses while bowed beyond its own, and rosin's friction on every string (registry/objects/bowed.json violin-family bow.hairStiffness, hairDamping, stringLoss, friction; Matusiak & Chatziioannou 2024, Lampis et al. 2024): the attacks from rest on Lampis' string A within 20 periods as often as the robot's, 236 of its 859 to its 188, where Artifastring's made 27 (native/strings-model/lampis_guettler.py), each part alone short of it; off, Artifastring's rigid contact, its strings' own losses and its tables' friction. Off until the laws are fitted under it (neutral.py fit, its maps stamped with it): a force measured under the one is played under the other moved by their frictions (friction-drop-scale), which keeps it under Schelleng's most force but not over his least, the bowed losses and the hair raising the least force more than the friction lowers it (a contrabass's mf bow moved from 5.06 N to 2.11 N double-slipped where 3 N held Helmholtz motion, 7 November 2026). The bodies' corrections, levels and pizzicati are measured through the engine, and are measured again when it changes (native/strings-model/README.md)

bow-planner.about: A bowed string's bow planned through the performer contract's solver (public/shared/performers/bow.js planBowing): where the bow is, which way it moves, how much of it each note spends, where it may change direction -- the reference the tests hold a bowed line to, never called while playing.
bow-planner.source: ours (the general performer-instrument report, sections 5.4 and C03)

together.reason: notes starting within this of each other one group

positionGrain.reason: bow positions within this one state

setDown.unit: shares of the bow from the frog
setDown.reason: where a stroke may be set down to begin, a phrase's first or after a retake

costHidden.reason: a change inside a held note's: an articulation changed

same.reason: two pitches or places the same within this: a float's rounding

bowed-line.about: A bowed string's phrase planned with its bow (public/shared/performers/bowed-line.js planPhrase): the shared line (line.js) carried to the instrument, its bowing, and its bow distributed stroke by stroke by construction -- each stroke at its dynamic's speed where the bow has room, slower where it hasn't, set back in a silence long enough for a retake, a slur the slowest bow cannot draw divided.

density.reason: a phrase planned without its arc's density given plays at this (its caller's own given otherwise)

loudness.reason: and without its loudness given, at this

joinWithin.reason: a slurred note sounding into the next within this joins its stroke

same.reason: two places or times the same within this: a float's rounding

marginGrains.reason: the bow kept this many grains of its position (bow.js positionGrain) from either end

bisections.reason: a stroke's one share of its notes' speeds found by halving its interval this many times: to a double's precision

repairsPerNote.reason: a phrase whose stroke can't be drawn repaired at most this many times a note

strings-harmonics.about: The strings' natural harmonics as the model was qualified to sound them (public/shared/performers/physical-harmonics-calibration.json: one probe per instrument, variant, string and partial at mf, accepted where its partial holds; research/physical-neural-synthesis): a light contact at a node, and the bow it was probed with.

partials.reason: the harmonics qualified: the first two above the fundamental, light contact keeping the full string; higher partials and a second stopping finger not yet qualified

firmness.reason: the light contact's firmness, Artifastring's Kf multiplier, as probed (its method: Kf=0.001)

contact.reason: the bow's contact, on the whole string, as probed

force.reason: its force at mf's speed, as probed (scaled with its speed)

speed.reason: its speed at mf, as probed (scaled with the dynamic's)

velocityWithin.reason: a harmonic played further than this from the probe's velocity (mf) is said to lie outside what was measured

regions-selftest.about: regions.py's selftest: the edge search on windows known in advance, no engine -- Schelleng's shape (the least force growing faster than the most as the bow nears the bridge), a window wider than the grid each way, one none of the grid's forces is in, one narrower than a grid step.

shape.reason: Schelleng's shape: a window's least and most force each this over its contact

wide.reason: a window wider than the grid each way

beyond.reason: a window above every grid force

narrow.reason: a window narrower than a grid step

grid.reason: the grid's least and most force, log-spaced over strings-regions' forces

strings-noise-profile.about: A bowed note's regime read from its sound alone (native/strings-model/noise_profile.py; STRINGS_ARTICULATION_FIT_PLAN 3a): the model's notes over a coarse grid of contact, force and speed, each rendered as its bridge force and its sound, the force's regime labelling the sound's features; two judgements, each a logistic regression of the standardized features fitted by Newton's method on its convex likelihood (deterministic, no draws), per instrument -- scratch (too heavy for its bow) and clean (Helmholtz motion) -- accepted only where it agrees with the bridge force at bow places it was not fitted on and where recorded players' clean notes read clean.

betas.reason: the coarse grid's bow-bridge distances, across the robot's 0.02 to 0.2 (schelleng-map betas)

leastForce.reason: the grid's least force, the violin's (an instrument's times its force scale): under the robot's least (0.1 N)

forceSpan.reason: the grid's forces up to this many times its least (12.5 N for the violin), past the players' most (2.5 N)

forceDigits.reason: each force written to a tenth of a millinewton, as the driver's actions carry it

highestStop.reason: each instrument's lowest string bowed open and its highest stopped a fifth up: both ends of its strings and a stopped string's shorter length

note.reason: each grid note held this long, its features read over its last half

gap.reason: then lifted and its string damped over this before the next

seed.reason: the engine's seed for every grid render: its bridge force and its sound the same motion

window.reason: each window of a note's sound read for its features this many periods long (its jitter how far its period wanders from one window to the next)

types.reason: the grid's instruments where none are asked: the violin, viola, cello and contrabass (bowed-instruments.js BOWED's order), the violello apart

jobs.reason: renders at once: three, the trunk's share for a strings fit

shownEvery.reason: its progress shown every this many files

lead.reason: a grid file's first note this long in

dampBefore.reason: each note's string given back its own losses this long before its stroke

fingerBefore.reason: its finger set this long before its stroke

ramp.reason: its finger, its bow's start and each change of its losses made over this, a finger's least: a finger set at once on a ringing string had clicked

accelerating.reason: its bow's speed reached over this from rest

lift.reason: its bow lifted over this at its note's end

dampAfter.reason: its string damped this long after its bow's lift

damped.reason: its string's losses this many times its own between notes, so each note begins from silence

leastLag.reason: a period sought no shorter than this: the shortest a sampled sound holds (the Nyquist frequency's)

lagSpan.reason: its period sought within 3% of f0's

lagMargin.reason: and to a sample past the span's top, its truncation

leastPeriods.reason: a window read only where it holds this many periods past its longest lag

lagSteps.reason: its fractional lag found by this many golden-section steps, deterministic: to 0.618^24, about 1e-5, of a sample's search

repeats.reason: a motion repeating every two or three periods (raucous): how alike it is there, and its energy at its harmonics' halves and thirds

flown.reason: a string flown to its octave or its twelfth (multiple slipping) sounds only its even harmonics or its thirds

mostHarmonics.reason: its harmonics read up to the fortieth

nyquistShare.reason: and below this share of the highest frequency its rate holds

harmonicBand.reason: each harmonic read within f0 over this either side of it

noiseFrom.reason: its noise and subharmonics read from this share of f0 up

dividedHarmonics.reason: how divided its harmonics are read on its first twelve

fundamentalHarmonics.reason: its fundamental's share read of its first eight harmonics' energy

jitterWindows.reason: its jitter read only where this many windows' periods were found

jitterFloor.reason: its jitter's logarithm floored here: a period steadier than a ten-thousandth of itself reads as that

ridge.reason: each judgement's logistic regression penalized this much (ridge, its bias apart), so separable notes still give finite weights

tolerance.reason: Newton's method stopped where no weight moves more than this

scaleFloor.reason: a feature's spread floored here, so a feature that never changes standardizes to zero

decision.reason: a judgement says yes at even odds or over

banks.reason: the recorded players' notes read where none are asked: the vendored banks with bowed sustains (Iowa MIS, VSCO 2 CE)

attackUnmeasured.reason: a recording whose attack was not measured taken as attacking over this

pastAttack.reason: a recording's steady part read from this long past its attack

beforeRelease.reason: to this long before its release

leastSteady.reason: a recording read only where its steady part is this long

mostSteady.reason: and read for this long at most

noise-profile-selftest.about: noise_profile.py's selftest: the features of made sounds -- a sawtooth like a bowed string's, periodic, clean, its fundamental strong; the same with a subharmonic, repeating every second period; noise -- each told apart.

rate.reason: its sounds made at this rate, the banks'

subharmonic.reason: the subharmonic a half-period motion adds this large

periodic.reason: the sawtooth read periodic over this

quietDb.reason: its noise and subharmonics under this

apartDb.reason: the subharmonic's and the noise's own levels this much over the sawtooth's

schelleng-regime.about: Which regime a steady bowed bridge force is in -- Helmholtz, multiple, raucous, slipping or silent -- by P. M. Galluzzo's waveform identification (2004, section 4.2.3, after Woodhouse; the algorithm the robot's own authors used): the bridge force scaled by 1/v_b, the rise a sticking string makes taken from it, averaged over beta T, and its levels' histogram read, each stair a peak, the spacing between peaks a flyback (native/strings-model/schelleng.py). Galluzzo gives the criterion, not its numbers: they are set where its selftest classifies synthetic bridge forces of each regime every one as made.

periodic.reason: a sound is heard as a note where its periodicity at the period its finger stops is at least this (the strings' check's 'heard')

slip.reason: a fall in the force: a run of steps over this share of the period's steepest, dropping the force at least this share of its largest fall

quiet.reason: silent under this share of the string's Helmholtz amplitude at that bow (no motion kept)

stair.reason: its peaks' spacings within this of 2 Z / beta, and its stairs' share within this: Galluzzo's tolerance, set where the selftest classifies every synthetic regime as made

peak.reason: a stair's peak stands over this share of the histogram's tallest bin: set where the selftest classifies every synthetic regime as made

steady.reason: a robot measurement's steady part: its bow's speed within this of its plateau's, the later half of that

robotRate.reason: the robot's recordings' rate (Lampis et al.'s whole_N.csv at 50 kHz)

speedFloor.reason: a bow's speed never under this as the force is read against it: a stopped bow divides nothing

stairWidth.reason: a level on a stair within a step over this of a peak's

leastBins.reason: the staircase's histogram at least this many bins

slippingSlips.reason: a staircase flat for less than all but this many slips' share of a period (each beta T), less its tolerance, is no staircase: the string slipping

lagSpan.reason: its periodicity read at lags across this span of the period its finger stops

subharmonicBand.reason: its subharmonic: the loudest component in this band under its fundamental

noSubharmonicDb.reason: its subharmonic where the band holds no component

floor.reason: a ratio's least before its logarithm: nothing, where it is none

robotHeld.reason: a robot measurement taken only where its bow held its plateau's speed this long or longer

robotTop.reason: its plateau's speed: this percentile of its bow's speeds

robotBand.reason: the robot's G2 strings' fundamental found in this band

schelleng-map.about: A string's Schelleng diagram mapped on the model as the robot's was on real strings (schelleng.py model): every force and bow-bridge distance of the robot's grid classified.

betas.reason: the robot's grid, Schoonderwaldt et al.'s before it: relative bow-bridge distances 0.02 to 0.2

type.reason: a model map where no instrument is asked: the cello, the robot's instrument (Lampis, Mayer & Chatziioannou 2024)

seconds.reason: each point held this long, read over its second half

speeds.reason: a model map's bow speeds where none are asked: three a factor of two apart from 0.05 m/s, a speed the robot bowed (27 October 2026, claude-scratch/strings-neutral/robot-both.json)

forces.reason: the robot's forces, 0.1 to 4 N, 24 log-spaced, to the millinewton

schelleng-selftest.about: The classifier's selftest (native/strings-model/schelleng.py selftest): synthetic bridge forces of each regime, made as the physics makes them -- a sawtooth rising 2 Z v / beta a period with Schelleng's ripples and noise, two flybacks a period, flybacks only every few periods, a small sinusoid, noise -- across bow-bridge distances, both bow directions and seeds; each must be classified as made.

f0.reason: the synthetic string's fundamental: the robot's G2

impedance.reason: its impedance: the robot's A-type G string's measured

beta.reason: its bow-bridge distance where none is given

speed.reason: its bow's speed where none is given

ripple.reason: Schelleng's ripples, period beta T, this large

slippingSize.reason: a slipping string's sinusoid this large

secondFlyback.reason: a multiple flyback's second slip this far into each period

raucousEvery.reason: a raucous string's flybacks every 2 to 4 periods, drawn (the upper end exclusive)

attack-transient.about: How long a bowed note takes to reach Helmholtz motion, and what it does meanwhile (native/strings-model/attack_transient.py): each note found in the bridge force, then the regime read on a window of periods stepped a period at a time, judged against the limits listeners accept.

window.reason: a window of periods each regime is read on

onset.reason: a note begins where its envelope (a period's mean |x|) stands over this share of the file's greatest

leastPeriods.reason: a note found only where its envelope stands over its onset for more than this many periods

shownRuns.reason: each note's first this many runs of regimes printed

strings-probe.about: The strings engine's driver as the fits play it (native/strings-model/probe.py): its rate, and how a note heard is ended.

rate.reason: the engine's rate: Artifastring's instrument sample rate (public/shared/float-wav.js's, where a file names none)

lift.reason: the bow lifted over this after a note heard

silent.reason: the string rung down by the driver to under a 24-bit file's smallest step at its own level: a render kept for the owner ends in silence, never cut

wavHeader.reason: the driver's output a 32-bit float mono WAV after a 44-byte header (calibrate-strings-model.mjs readFloatWav)

fullScale.reason: a driver's sample past this (or not finite) is one the model could not compute, silenced as a render's stem silences it (public/shared/float-wav.js floatWav reads it too): one such sample poisons a mix's every return after it

reach.reason: the probe's note: its bow brought to its speed over this from silence (the actions calibrate-strings-model.mjs note writes)

seconds.reason: a probe's note held this long where none is asked

heard.reason: a note heard over this much of its steady part, from the middle of its second half

bins.reason: its spectrum read at this many points

search.reason: its fundamental found within this of the pitch it is near

top.reason: to this, its harmonics counted to here

harmonicHz.reason: a component counts as a harmonic within this of one

harmonicShare.reason: or within this share of it, the wider

fractions.reason: a motion repeating every few periods looked for at these fractions of its fundamental

highs.reason: its highs: this band against the whole

shownDb.reason: a fraction printed where it stands within this of the loudest

floor.reason: a ratio's least before its logarithm: nothing, where it is none

strings-seat.about: A bowed string's seat in a section (public/bots/lib/modules/section-seat.js): its draws' streams, how far ahead it looks, and the tolerances it compares times and pitches within.

arrivalMost.reason: a seat's sound reaching the listener later than its section's nearest by under this is its seating's (seating.js), a later one refused as no seat's: about 34 m of air, past any stage's depth

saltBow.reason: its bow's draws one stream of its seat's (0xb0a): a name, any other distinct from its other streams' as good

saltTake.reason: its take's draw another stream (0x7a4e): a name

saltBite.reason: each note's bite another stream (0xb17e): a name

saltPace.reason: its tremolo's pace another stream (0x7e3): a name

takes.reason: a seat's first take of a pitch drawn among this many, far more than any bank records of one pitch, each change of bow the next (audio.js reads it modulo the bank's own)

least.reason: a phrase's share left or its length in s never taken under this as a divisor: at its end, or of no length, divided by this, not by zero

ahead.reason: a line told rubato by its conductor (part-rubato.js) looked into this many ticks ahead, as far as its arch is taken to move a note earlier: ours, the told arch bounded nowhere

same.reason: two times the same instant within this: a float's rounding

quickWithin.reason: a note quicker than its beat by more than this a quick one, slurred in a line's groups: a float's rounding of a written length

endWithin.reason: a note reaching the piece's end within this held open to the cutoff: a millisecond, under any written length

leastSlide.reason: a glissando's slide never shorter than this, a divisor: a millisecond

samePitch.reason: a pitch within this of the one held the same, repeated (never slurred to): a quarter of a semitone, wider than any player's own few cents or a microtonal tuning's retuning of one note

onGrid.reason: a note within this of a position of its metre's grid on it, weighed as it (else the grid's least): an eighth of a beat

strings-section.about: A bowed string section's seats, sizes and draws (public/shared/performers/string-section.js): the bounds it checks a size within, its seeds' span, a player's own stream, and its tolerance.

mostSeats.reason: a section's size refused past this many players: past any orchestra's (the full one's 16 first violins four times over), a typing slip's guard

seedSpan.reason: a pool's seed a whole number under this (2^31), a non-negative 32-bit integer as every seeded source takes it

saltPlayer.reason: a player's own inflection one stream of its seat's (0x51f7): a name, any other distinct from its other streams' as good

same.reason: a share of desks rounded up but for a float's rounding within this

seatsPerBot.reason: the most seats one bot plays: the kit's Surge XT patches voice eight notes at once (mass_clodbot MASS.lines, Surge's polylimit in the kit's patches)
